row_type.description: regime = one per book, READ FIRST; name = one scored security; record = the publisher's own benchmark-relative return.

book.description: Which book the row belongs to: S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, macro ETFs, or the BTC/ETH trend book.

asof.description: The publish date these scores are as of (YYYY-MM-DD).

delayed.description: True on the free tier (one market day behind); false with a Coil Scanner license.

regime_mode.description: Book-level verdict: NAMES_ON, SELECTIVE, SECTORS_ON, INDEX_ONLY or RISK_OFF.

verdict.description: Plain-language regime verdict for the book.

ladder_rung.description: Permission ladder rung. CASH means individual names are NOT enterable — the ranked names below are context, not a green light.

green_sectors.description: Sectors currently open beneath the index.

opp.description: Opportunity, 0-100. A percentile RANK across the scored universe on the publish date — not a return forecast.

entry_q.description: Entry quality, 0-100: buyable now versus extended. Timing only.

hold_q.description: Hold strength, 0-100: trend durability if a position already exists.

state.description: Entry lane: firing, ready, setup, wait, chase or falling. Never a buy or sell instruction.

is_leader.description: Whether the name is flagged as leadership.

engine_return_pct.description: The engine's own return since inception, funding-adjusted.

spy_return_pct.description: SPY buy-and-hold over the same window.

qqq_return_pct.description: QQQ buy-and-hold over the same window.

note.description: Sample-size and method note that must travel with the record.

proof.description: Append-only SHA-256 commitment log verifying the published scores were not changed after the fact.

overview.title: Board
overview.description: Regime verdict per book, then every scored name. Read top-down.

scores.title: Scores only
scores.description: Every scored name with all three scores — the shape to feed a model.
